text: Establish a calm sleep routine; the little one needs 11–14 hours, and any shortfall will show in his mood.

review_defects.why: The Arabic says 'مزاجه' (his mood/temperament), but the English translates it as 'akhlaq' (an Islamic term for character/morals) and then glosses it as 'disposition'. This changes the meaning from a temporary mood to a broader character trait, and introduces an Islamic term not present in the source.
